entities.summary: Late Soviet Period and Perestroika, a transformative movement in Tajikistan (1970–1991). Emerged from Collectivization and Cotton Monoculture and Revolution, Basmachi, and National Delimitation. Catalyzed Dushanbe riots over housing and ethnic tensions — prelude to civil war and Tajikistan declares independence.
